ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio (approx. 5:95) across the primary ventral surface; surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with minimal high-intensity noise.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black pigmentation across 95% of the surface area. High-intensity white speckling is sparsely distributed. High-intensity contiguous clusters (barnacle colonies) are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50-60 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; multiple sharp peaks and valleys with a pixel amplitude ranging from 5 to 15 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upward to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-contrast white pixels localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, unaligned linear white tracks on the right lobe: one long vertical mark extending approximately 25% of the lobe's height and one shorter diagonal mark nearby.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the margins of both lobe tips; distinct linear rake-style scarring on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical ridge texture and slight discoloration at the central base (peduncle attachment point).
